api_routing.call_entry: vfCall(stageSlug, user, onChunk) = callModel({provider (selected), system: activeStagePrompt(stageSlug), user, onText})
api_routing.mode: curated chain-walk (standalone) / native (artifact); or-text mapped to or-auto (openrouter/free)

execution.persistence: commit entries {seed,hint,score,converged,output,crystallization,confirm,trace,timestamp} unshifted to responses:vector-forge; prompt overrides to prompts:vector-forge

call.user_recipe: divergeContent(null) first fan / divergeContent(vector) on descend

steps.human: recognize vector (push to path) -> descend (fan finer) or forge

steps.loop: iter 1..maxIter; fidelity scores vs threshold each iter; track best; break on pass

execution.topology: fan-tree (human recognition branching) -> optimizer loop (crystallize -> architect/revise x fidelity-gated iters) -> off-loop confirm -> sealed commit + full-trace save

model_core.projection_note: registry build keeps linear active path (single branch) instead of full spine tree; prompt overrides editable per stage; folder-connect sync stays in full build

params_source: params.json (seed/hint inputs, Explorer-Commit switch, maxiter/threshold, provider select, libraries)
